notes: SOCIAL: send friend requests with a friend code (accept or decline), see which friends are online in the lobby and join them, and a friends leaderboard of online stats
PARTIES: party members are always put on the same team
MATCH START: a 5 second loading screen with a picture of the map, then 15 seconds to pick your class (no moving or shooting, last chance for players to join)
SPAWNS: every map has two spawn areas per team - two or more enemies in yours moves your team to the other one. 1.5 s spawn protection. Nobody (bots too) can leave the map
GUNS: every gun rebalanced, attachments now all do what they say, advanced stats shown in the loadout. Perfect first shot when aiming, then a little bloom
FIXES: muzzle flash and kick on iron sights toned down, stuns only blind people looking at them, more realistic grenade throws, Survival no longer stays frozen at the start
SETTINGS: ADS sensitivity for every scope zoom (mouse and controller), controller button remapping (Controller > Edit Controller Buttons), rename classes in the Weapons tab
NEW: lobby music (Music volume in Audio), a Replay tab to rewatch your last match on a tactical map, and Career mode stats now cover every online mode
